description: Capture an app's network traffic (HTTP), mock its answers, throttle it. paths: what each way sees here, or why not; start (via proxy: at proxy host:port; probe: restarts the app; bodies; strict); read (id: one request whole; contains, method, status; har: a proxy's export; save: a .har); check: waits for a request, failing with the nearest; mock (rules; add; from: a file of answers; unmatched); throttle; stop. The whole device: set_device network. Returns requests, bounded; installs no certificate.

from.description: rules from a request id or a .har

has.description: in its body: path=value or text

rules.description: Each "host/path* [method=] [query=] [regex=] [has=] [when=]" then "status= body= (@file) type= header=", "fail=offline|timeout|reset" or "to=host", and delayMs= times= off. Replaces; [] clears; none lists

strict.description: a 5xx or a failed request fails the action

throttle.description: full, slow, edge, 3g, lte, offline, bytes/s down, or "delayMs= down= up= loss="

name: capture_network
title: Network traffic
